item.title: VidMap Merges SLAM and SfM for Video-Based 3D Reconstruction, Debuts at ECCV 2026
item.summary: VidMap, an open-source system merging SLAM temporal tracking with global SfM optimization for accurate 3D reconstruction from unconstrained monocular video, has been released with code and paper ahead of ECCV 2026, drawing amplification from technology commentator Robert Scoble.
